reason: The negative estimate (-1.8) comes from controlling for mgmt_rating_2023, a post-treatment variable that training raises and that is also driven by productivity (a mediator/collider), which flips the sign. Without that control, the estimates are positive (+0.8 with pre-period controls, +2.4 unadjusted, all p<0.001). The report ran only one specification and did not justify including the post-period control.
